title: More Money Was Supposed to Help Poor Kids. So Why Didn’t It?

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: For many, the logic seemed unassailable.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，这个逻辑似乎无懈可击。

sentences.en: Giving poor families money would measurably improve the lives of their children.
sentences.zh: 给贫困家庭提供资金，将能切实改善他们孩子的生活。

sentences.en: And so, a few years ago, social scientists set out to test whether that assumption was right.
sentences.zh: 因此，几年前，社会科学家们着手测试这一假设是否正确。

sentences.en: But the results of that test have shocked them.
sentences.zh: 但测试结果却让他们感到震惊。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Jason De Parle on how a groundbreaking experiment has undercut deeply held assumptions about how to end the cycle of childhood poverty.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事杰森·德帕尔将讲述一项开创性的实验，是如何动摇了关于如何终结童年贫困循环的深层假设的。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, August 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月6日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jason, you've been reporting on poverty and the efforts to address it for decades.
sentences.zh: 杰森，几十年来你一直在报道贫困问题以及为解决贫困所做的努力。

sentences.en: You've written books on the subject.
sentences.zh: 你还写过关于这个主题的书。

sentences.en: So, tell me about this study that has really shaken the policy world that you cover.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲这项真正震撼了你所报道的政策界的研究吧。

sentences.en: It's long been clear that children in affluent families do better than their low-income peers on measures of cognitive development and behavior.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，显而易见的是，富裕家庭的孩子在认知发展和行为指标上都优于低收入家庭的孩子。

sentences.en: The question has always been why.
sentences.zh: 问题一直在于原因是什么。

sentences.en: Is it the money itself that makes a difference?
sentences.zh: 是金钱本身产生了影响吗？

sentences.en: Or is it associated factors?
sentences.zh: 还是与之相关的其他因素？

sentences.en: Like, maybe their parents have more education.
sentences.zh: 比如，也许他们的父母受教育程度更高。

sentences.en: Maybe they live in better neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 也许他们居住在更好的社区。

sentences.en: Maybe they have access to better schools.
sentences.zh: 也许他们能获得更好的学校教育。

sentences.en: Maybe they have access to better child care.
sentences.zh: 也许他们能获得更好的托儿服务。

sentences.en: There's lots of indirect evidence that suggests poverty itself causes negative child outcomes.
sentences.zh: 有很多间接证据表明，贫困本身导致了儿童负面的成长结果。

sentences.en: But there hasn't been a study that isolates the effect of cash itself.
sentences.zh: 但此前还没有一项研究能将现金本身的影响单独剥离出来。

sentences.en: And this is a big policy question because most advanced countries do provide some sort of unconditional cash aid to parents raising children.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大的政策问题，因为大多数发达国家确实会向抚养孩子的父母提供某种形式的无条件现金援助。

sentences.en: The United States is unusual in that it does not.
sentences.zh: 美国比较特殊，它没有这样做。

sentences.en: And the Democrats and progressives are eager to change that.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和进步派人士非常渴望改变这一点。

sentences.en: So, this question has a high public policy potential relevance.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个问题具有很高的公共政策潜力。

sentences.en: So, a group of prominent researchers set out to try to isolate the effect of money alone on children's development.
sentences.zh: 因此，一群杰出的研究人员着手尝试单独剥离金钱对儿童发展的影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the question these researchers are trying to answer is, essentially, if we give money to families with no strings attached,
sentences.zh: 这些研究人员试图回答的问题本质上是：如果我们给家庭提供无附加条件的资金，

sentences.en: will their kids benefit from that specifically in terms of child development?
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子是否会从中受益，特别是在儿童发展方面？

sentences.en: That's the goal here.
sentences.zh: 这就是目标所在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The hopes of the proponents of unconditional cash aid is that it could help level the playing field.
sentences.zh: 无条件现金援助的支持者希望这能有助于创造公平的竞争环境。

sentences.en: That it could help give low-income children some of the opportunities that high-income children have.
sentences.zh: 这能帮助低收入家庭的孩子获得一些高收入家庭孩子所拥有的机会。

sentences.en: So, it has potentially profound consequences.
sentences.zh: 所以，它可能产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: And what'd they find?
sentences.zh: 他们发现了什么？

sentences.en: This group of researchers found that after four years, there were no detectable differences between the children that got the aid and the children that didn't get the aid.
sentences.zh: 这组研究人员发现，四年后，获得援助的孩子和没有获得援助的孩子之间没有可检测到的差异。

sentences.en: No detectable differences at all?
sentences.zh: 完全没有可检测到的差异？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The money, as far as the researchers could tell, has not made a difference.
sentences.zh: 据研究人员所知，这笔钱并没有产生影响。

sentences.en: Which was such a surprise, the researchers themselves are quite divided over what to make of it.
sentences.zh: 这太令人惊讶了，研究人员自己对于如何解读这一结果也存在很大分歧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太引人入胜了。

sentences.en: Let's get into the study itself.
sentences.zh: 让我们深入了解这项研究本身。

sentences.en: How was it designed?
sentences.zh: 它是如何设计的？

sentences.en: The study's called Baby's First Years.
sentences.zh: 这项研究被称为“婴儿的最初几年”。

sentences.en: It came together about a decade ago when a group of prominent researchers set out to try to isolate the effect of money alone on children's development.
sentences.zh: 它始于大约十年前，当时一群杰出的研究人员着手尝试单独剥离金钱对儿童发展的影响。

sentences.en: It was quite an elaborate effort.
sentences.zh: 这是一项相当复杂的工程。

sentences.en: They raised $22 million, some of it from the government, some of it from private foundations.
sentences.zh: 他们筹集了2200万美元，部分来自政府，部分来自私人基金会。

sentences.en: They, in a team of assistants, recruited 1,000 mothers from 12 hospitals in four cities.
sentences.zh: 他们和一组助手在四个城市的12家医院招募了1000名母亲。

sentences.en: They got them ready when the mothers were giving birth and then followed them for four years on all kinds of measures.
sentences.zh: 他们在母亲分娩时做好准备，然后对她们进行了四年的各种指标跟踪。

sentences.en: They had neuroscientists involved.
sentences.zh: 他们有神经科学家参与。

sentences.en: They had economists involved.
sentences.zh: 他们有经济学家参与。

sentences.en: They had ethnographers involved.
sentences.zh: 他们有人种学家参与。

sentences.en: They had psychologists involved.
sentences.zh: 他们有心理学家参与。

sentences.en: They looked at every aspect of child development.
sentences.zh: 他们观察了儿童发展的方方面面。

sentences.en: And they divided them at random into two groups.
sentences.zh: 他们将她们随机分成了两组。

sentences.en: One group got $333 a month in cash stipends, unconditional.
sentences.zh: 一组每月获得333美元的现金津贴，无附加条件。

sentences.en: The other got a nominal $20 just for participating in the study.
sentences.zh: 另一组仅因参与研究而获得象征性的20美元。

sentences.en: A random control study is considered a kind of gold standard in scientific experimentation because it attempts to weed out the other forms of influences on the results.
sentences.zh: 随机对照研究被认为是科学实验中的“黄金标准”，因为它试图排除其他形式对结果的影响。

sentences.en: This gives you a kind of scientific result, the way drug trials work, right, where you give half the group a placebo and half the group the drug.
sentences.zh: 这能给你一种科学的结果，就像药物试验一样，对吧？给一半人服用安慰剂，另一半人服用药物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The idea of randomized control is that you really isolate the effect of the intervention itself.
sentences.zh: 随机对照的理念是，你真正剥离了干预措施本身的影响。

sentences.en: It's like if this is the only thing you're changing in this scenario, is that making a difference?
sentences.zh: 就像如果这是你在这个场景中唯一改变的东西，它是否产生了影响？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: That was the hope.
sentences.zh: 这就是希望所在。

sentences.en: Can we pause here just for a sec?
sentences.zh: 我们能在这里暂停一下吗？

sentences.en: Because I have to ask about the dollar amount itself.
sentences.zh: 因为我必须问一下金额本身的问题。

sentences.en: Because by my math, it's $330-ish a month, about $4,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 因为按我的计算，大约每月330美元，一年约4000美元。

sentences.en: That's just not that much.
sentences.zh: 那真的不算多。

sentences.en: Let me step back for just a second and explain the two theories about why cash aid would help child development.
sentences.zh: 让我退一步，简单解释一下关于现金援助为何能帮助儿童发展的两种理论。

sentences.en: One is an economic theory.
sentences.zh: 一种是经济理论。

sentences.en: It lets families buy more stuff.
sentences.zh: 它让家庭能买更多的东西。

sentences.en: The kids get better food.
sentences.zh: 孩子们能吃到更好的食物。

sentences.en: They can live in better neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 他们能住在更好的社区。

sentences.en: They have more toys or books, and therefore they grow and they thrive.
sentences.zh: 他们有更多的玩具或书籍，因此他们成长并茁壮成长。

sentences.en: The second, and they're not mutually exclusive, is a stress model.
sentences.zh: 第二种，它们并不相互排斥，是压力模型。

sentences.en: There's lots of evidence that the stress levels in low-income families are just really high.
sentences.zh: 有大量证据表明，低收入家庭的压力水平确实非常高。

sentences.en: You know, people worrying about utility cutoffs, evictions, and that the anxiety gets translated onto the kids, and this affects their child development.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们担心水电费断供、被驱逐，这种焦虑会转移到孩子身上，从而影响他们的发展。

sentences.en: I think it's important to remember that all the women, all the mothers in this study were below the federal poverty line.
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是要记住，这项研究中的所有女性，所有母亲，都处于联邦贫困线以下。

sentences.en: So a $4,000 a year increase to their income was about an 18% increase.
sentences.zh: 所以每年增加4000美元的收入，大约是18%的增长。

sentences.en: It's not transformative, but they thought it would be enough to be a meaningful test of what difference cash aid could make.
sentences.zh: 这虽然不是变革性的，但他们认为这足以成为一个有意义的测试，看看现金援助能带来什么不同。

sentences.en: At the same time, I would say there were some concerns among some advisors to the group that maybe the sum wasn't going to be large enough to produce the results they expected.
sentences.zh: 同时，我也想说，该小组的一些顾问担心，这笔钱可能不足以产生他们预期的结果。

sentences.en: So there was two pathways through which the increased cash aid could have helped children.
sentences.zh: 所以，增加现金援助可以通过两条途径帮助孩子。

sentences.en: And to their credit, the researchers pre-registered seven hypotheses about what effect the cash aid would have.
sentences.zh: 值得称赞的是，研究人员预先注册了七个关于现金援助会有什么影响的假设。

sentences.en: There were measures of children's vocabulary, their executive function, their pre-literacy skills, their spatial perception.
sentences.zh: 其中包括衡量儿童词汇量、执行功能、识字前技能、空间感知能力的指标。

sentences.en: They had mothers rank them on assessments of social and emotional behavior.
sentences.zh: 他们让母亲们对社会和情感行为的评估进行排名。

sentences.en: And how do you get at the question of, you know, is someone developing cognitively?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何解决这个问题呢，你知道，一个人是否在认知上发展？

sentences.en: Like, how do you actually tell if that's happening?
sentences.zh: 比如，你实际上怎么判断这种情况是否正在发生？

sentences.en: This is where I thought they were really innovative and energetic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们在这里非常有创新精神和活力。

sentences.en: They went as far as measuring brainwave activity in infants by going to their homes and giving them electroencephalograms,
sentences.zh: 他们甚至通过去婴儿家中为他们做脑电图来测量婴儿的脑电波活动，

sentences.en: which are these tests where you attach electrodes to infants' heads and try to detect brain activity
sentences.zh: 这是一种将电极连接到婴儿头部并试图检测大脑活动的测试，

sentences.en: and see if there are increases in brainwaves that might predict future cognitive development.
sentences.zh: 看看是否有脑电波的增加，这可能预示着未来的认知发展。

sentences.en: They went from that to self-reports on the mothers, on their children's health and behavior, to cognitive tests,
sentences.zh: 他们从这些测试，到母亲对孩子健康和行为的自我报告，再到认知测试，

sentences.en: just a wide range of measures trying to look at all elements of the family's life.
sentences.zh: 涵盖了广泛的指标，试图观察家庭生活的各个方面。

sentences.en: And why are they looking at children at this age, you know, from birth?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们要观察这个年龄段的孩子，你知道，从出生开始？

sentences.en: What's important about that?
sentences.zh: 这有什么重要性？

sentences.en: I think there's two reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为有两个原因。

sentences.en: One, there's just a realm of evidence of the importance of the formative years, that so much of what happens in the first few years sets the trajectory for a child's development.
sentences.zh: 第一，有大量的证据表明形成期的重要性，头几年发生的事情在很大程度上决定了孩子发展的轨迹。

sentences.en: And also it mirrors this policy debate about cash aid.
sentences.zh: 而且它也反映了关于现金援助的政策辩论。

sentences.en: If you're going to give cash aid, I think the theory is you can have a bigger impact if you target younger children than if you simply give it adults.
sentences.zh: 如果你要提供现金援助，我认为理论上，如果你针对的是年幼的孩子，比单纯给成年人提供援助会有更大的影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the idea, again, is that if you give moms cash, that in and of itself could lead to improvements on any one of these metrics or on various.
sentences.zh: 同样，这个想法是，如果你给妈妈们现金，这本身就可能导致这些指标中任何一个或多个方面的改善。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个想法。

sentences.en: That's certainly what the advocates of unconditional cash aid hope.
sentences.zh: 这当然是无条件现金援助倡导者所希望的。

sentences.en: But again, because it's unconditional, they can spend it however they want.
sentences.zh: 但同样，因为它是无条件的，她们可以随心所欲地花钱。

sentences.en: There are certainly people who oppose the idea that worry giving families money with no strings attached will hurt them, that the mothers will misuse the money.
sentences.zh: 当然有人反对这种想法，担心给家庭提供无附加条件的钱会伤害他们，担心母亲会滥用这些钱。

sentences.en: They'll spend it on drugs or alcohol or it'll incentivize them to quit their jobs and the families will actually become poorer.
sentences.zh: 他们会把钱花在毒品或酒精上，或者这会激励她们辞职，家庭反而会变得更穷。

sentences.en: But after four years of cash payments, the researchers found the mothers didn't misuse the money.
sentences.zh: 但在四年的现金支付后，研究人员发现母亲们并没有滥用这些钱。

sentences.en: They didn't spend more on alcohol or drugs.
sentences.zh: 她们没有在酒精或毒品上花更多的钱。

sentences.en: They didn't spend more on cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 她们没有在香烟上花更多的钱。

sentences.en: In fact, they did spend more on their kids.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她们确实在孩子身上花了更多的钱。

sentences.en: They spent $68 a month more on toys and books and child care and services for their kids.
sentences.zh: 她们每月多花68美元在玩具、书籍、托儿服务和为孩子提供的服务上。

sentences.en: And they spent a little more time with their kids.
sentences.zh: 而且她们花在孩子身上的时间也多了一点。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, none of that spending and none of that time affected the main yardsticks of child development in the ways they predicted.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，所有这些支出和时间都没有按照他们预测的方式影响儿童发展的主要衡量标准。

sentences.en: It didn't change the brainwave activity in the children.
sentences.zh: 它没有改变儿童的脑电波活动。

sentences.en: It didn't make their mothers rank them higher on assessments of social or emotional behavior.
sentences.zh: 它没有让母亲们在社会或情感行为评估中给他们更高的评价。

sentences.en: It didn't improve their vocabulary or their executive function or their pre-literacy skills or their spatial perception.
sentences.zh: 它没有改善他们的词汇量、执行功能、识字前技能或空间感知能力。

sentences.en: And the mothers didn't work less.
sentences.zh: 而且母亲们并没有减少工作。

sentences.en: They used the money responsibly.
sentences.zh: 她们负责任地使用了这笔钱。

sentences.en: But it didn't affect the kids in the way the researchers had predicted.
sentences.zh: 但它并没有按照研究人员预测的方式影响孩子。

sentences.en: — The mothers are using this money on their kids, but the researchers find that that spending has no effect.
sentences.zh: — 母亲们把钱花在孩子身上，但研究人员发现这种支出没有任何效果。

sentences.en: It doesn't cause an improvement on any of the seven metrics.
sentences.zh: 它没有导致七个指标中任何一个的改善。

sentences.en: That is just pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这真是太了不起了。

sentences.en: — Yes, and it's important to remember the researchers didn't predict it would necessarily change all seven.
sentences.zh: — 是的，重要的是要记住，研究人员并没有预测它一定会改变所有七个指标。

sentences.en: I think what's particularly striking is that it didn't change any of the seven.
sentences.zh: 我认为特别引人注目的是，它一个都没有改变。

sentences.en: So then the question becomes, why?
sentences.zh: 所以问题就变成了，为什么？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: — 我是Wynna Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: — I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: — 我是Sam Mazursky，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: — New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: — 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请前往 nytimes.com/games，立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: — Jason, $22 million, years-long study, very rigorous study.
sentences.zh: ——杰森，2200万美元，历时多年的研究，非常严谨的研究。

sentences.en: No impact is found on any of the things that they're expecting to see an impact on.
sentences.zh: 在他们预期会产生影响的任何方面，都没有发现任何影响。

sentences.en: You said it.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: I'm dying to know why.
sentences.zh: 我太想知道为什么了。

sentences.en: — The researchers themselves aren't sure why, and they disagree among themselves about whether they can generalize from these results
sentences.zh: ——研究人员自己也不确定原因，而且他们对于能否将这些结果推广到

sentences.en: to the broader question of whether cash aid helps kids.
sentences.zh: “现金援助是否有助于儿童”这一更广泛的问题上，也存在分歧。

sentences.en: — One possibility is that the pandemic interfered.
sentences.zh: ——一种可能性是疫情造成了干扰。

sentences.en: The pandemic occurred when the kids were about a year old.
sentences.zh: 疫情发生时，这些孩子大约一岁。

sentences.en: The pandemic could have interfered in at least two ways.
sentences.zh: 疫情可能通过至少两种方式造成了干扰。

sentences.en: One, it just disrupted everybody's life.
sentences.zh: 第一，它扰乱了每个人的生活。

sentences.en: Families came home from work, or in many cases, poor families weren't able to come home from work.
sentences.zh: 家庭成员下班回家，或者在许多情况下，贫困家庭根本无法下班回家。

sentences.en: They were still out there trying to make a living.
sentences.zh: 他们依然在外面努力谋生。

sentences.en: They had lots of stress.
sentences.zh: 他们承受着巨大的压力。

sentences.en: People's living arrangements changed.
sentences.zh: 人们的居住安排发生了变化。

sentences.en: It's just a really bad environment to try to isolate something like the effect of a $300-a-month stipend.
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间试图孤立出类似“每月300美元津贴”的影响，环境实在太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to do a social experiment in the midst of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 没人想在疫情期间做社会实验。

sentences.en: The researchers obviously couldn't have known this going into it.
sentences.zh: 研究人员在开始时显然不可能预见到这一点。

sentences.en: But a second way in which the pandemic could have skewed the results is that it triggered lots of other forms of government aid,
sentences.zh: 但疫情可能扭曲结果的第二种方式是，它触发了许多其他形式的政府援助，

sentences.en: which the families in the control group also received.
sentences.zh: 而对照组的家庭也收到了这些援助。

sentences.en: So it made the size of the experimental payments even smaller relative to the other aid families were getting.
sentences.zh: 因此，相对于家庭获得的其他援助，实验性补贴的金额就显得更小了。

sentences.en: It may be one thing to get a $333 payment when you're not getting other forms of aid.
sentences.zh: 当你没有获得其他形式的援助时，获得333美元的补贴可能是一回事。

sentences.en: It's another thing when you're getting it on top of thousands of dollars a year in other forms of emergency aid.
sentences.zh: 但当你是在每年数千美元的其他紧急援助之上再获得这笔钱时，情况就完全不同了。

sentences.en: So maybe just the government spending overwhelmed the effect of these experimental stipends.
sentences.zh: 所以，也许仅仅是政府的支出就掩盖了这些实验性津贴的效果。

sentences.en: Yeah, the idea here is that basically if you have a government that's giving out a lot of money anyway, you blunt the impact of this other cash payment.
sentences.zh: 没错，这里的观点基本上是，如果政府本来就在发放大量资金，你就会削弱这种额外现金支付的影响。

sentences.en: Like, it's not going to be in and of itself that important in that context.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，在这种背景下，它本身不会那么重要。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: And another way in which the pandemic might have shaped the results is that it triggered high inflation, which eroded the value of the cash stipend over time.
sentences.zh: 疫情可能影响结果的另一种方式是，它引发了高通胀，随着时间的推移，这侵蚀了现金津贴的价值。

sentences.en: Initially, it was an 18% bump in income for the families that received the cash aid, but that steadily shrank with the impact of inflation.
sentences.zh: 最初，对于获得现金援助的家庭来说，这相当于收入增加了18%，但随着通胀的影响，这一比例稳步缩小。

sentences.en: And a final caveat is that the experiment's not over.
sentences.zh: 最后一个注意事项是，实验还没有结束。

sentences.en: These results measure the impact of four years of payments.
sentences.zh: 这些结果衡量的是四年支付的影响。

sentences.en: The payments went on for six years, so at some point we'll get data on two more years of results, and it's possible the picture will change.
sentences.zh: 支付持续了六年，所以我们迟早会得到未来两年的结果数据，情况可能会发生变化。

sentences.en: But four years of results is a lot of results, and some evidence shows that child interventions actually fade with time rather than increase.
sentences.zh: 但四年的结果已经很多了，而且一些证据表明，针对儿童的干预措施的效果实际上会随时间减弱，而不是增强。

sentences.en: But no, we don't know for sure.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在还不能确定。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: While all of these extenuating circumstances, caveats, seem completely legitimate, maybe the pandemic and inflation obscured or blunted some of the effect.
sentences.zh: 虽然所有这些情有可原的情况和注意事项看起来都完全合理，也许疫情和通胀掩盖或削弱了部分效果。

sentences.en: But if unrestricted cash had the benefits that people were kind of hoping it might have, don't you think you would see it show up somewhere?
sentences.zh: 但如果无条件现金确实有人们所希望的那种好处，你不觉得它应该在某个地方显现出来吗？

sentences.en: Well, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 嗯，绝对应该。

sentences.en: One of the possible explanations for why the aid didn't have the expected impact is that it was wrong to expect it from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 援助没有产生预期影响的可能解释之一是，从一开始就期待它产生影响就是错误的。

sentences.en: And the researchers themselves are quite divided over what to make of it.
sentences.zh: 研究人员自己对于如何看待这些结果也存在严重分歧。

sentences.en: One caution to me, you can't make anything of it.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，一个警示是，你无法从中得出任何结论。

sentences.en: It's just a Rorschach teSt.
sentences.zh: 这就像罗夏墨迹测验一样。

sentences.en: People will project their own preferences upon it.
sentences.zh: 人们会将自己的偏好投射到上面。

sentences.en: And another, quite a prominent researcher named Greg Duncan, who's an economist at the University of California, Irvine,
sentences.zh: 另一位非常著名的研究人员，加州大学欧文分校的经济学家格雷格·邓肯，

sentences.en: told me that these results have prompted him to change his views.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，这些结果促使他改变了观点。

sentences.en: He has been surprised, and he thinks they can't simply be dismissed away as the product of low stipends or pandemic interference.
sentences.zh: 他感到很惊讶，他认为这些结果不能简单地归结为津贴金额过低或疫情干扰。

sentences.en: Greg is one of the most prominent researchers in the field.
sentences.zh: 格雷格是该领域最著名的研究人员之一。

sentences.en: He's spent decades studying the impact of government aid on children.
sentences.zh: 他花了数十年时间研究政府援助对儿童的影响。

sentences.en: He still thinks that government aid does a lot to boost children's development, but these results have made him question the impact of unconditional cash payments.
sentences.zh: 他仍然认为政府援助对促进儿童发展大有裨益，但这些结果让他开始质疑无条件现金支付的影响。

sentences.en: He's the only one who so far has come to that conclusion.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他是唯一得出这一结论的人。

sentences.en: It sounds like he's questioning his own assumptions, which obviously is hard to do.
sentences.zh: 听起来他是在质疑自己的假设，这显然很难做到。

sentences.en: Why do you think he's alone in that?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么只有他一个人这么想？

sentences.en: I think there's a legitimate, substantive, academic disagreement over how to interpret a complicated body of evidence.
sentences.zh: 我认为在如何解读复杂的证据体系方面，存在合理的、实质性的学术分歧。

sentences.en: I think there's also some concern among the group about publicizing these data for fear that others will use them as an argument or a pretext to cut government aid.
sentences.zh: 我也认为该群体中有人担心公开这些数据，因为担心其他人会将其用作削减政府援助的论据或借口。

sentences.en: Because the results are coming at a time, a pretty fraught time for government aid itself.
sentences.zh: 因为这些结果出现的时机，对于政府援助本身来说是一个相当令人担忧的时刻。

sentences.en: I mean, the Trump administration has been going about making some pretty extreme cuts to the social safety net recently.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普政府最近一直在对社会安全网进行一些相当极端的削减。

sentences.en: Yeah, the idea of providing cash guarantees to young children is a top social policy priority for the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 是的，为幼儿提供现金保障的想法是民主党的首要社会政策优先事项。

sentences.en: So there's that context, but then there's also the much larger context of the Trump administration cutting back significantly on all sorts of government aid,
sentences.zh: 所以有这样的背景，但还有更宏大的背景，即特朗普政府大幅削减了各种政府援助，

sentences.en: and some of the researchers thinking that, gee, this isn't the time to publicize potentially ambivalent results from one cash experiment during a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 一些研究人员认为，天哪，现在不是在疫情期间公布一项现金实验中潜在的矛盾结果的时候。

sentences.en: To give you an example of how the context has changed, they did publish year one results, which showed some tentative improvements in the children's brain activity
sentences.zh: 举个例子说明背景是如何变化的，他们确实发布了第一年的结果，显示儿童的大脑活动有一些初步的改善，

sentences.en: in a way that could predict better cognitive development.
sentences.zh: 这种改善方式可以预示更好的认知发展。

sentences.en: That paper was published in a journal, and they were all happy to discuss that.
sentences.zh: 那篇论文发表在期刊上，他们都很乐意讨论。

sentences.en: It seemed very promising.
sentences.zh: 看起来非常有希望。

sentences.en: It was also a different time politically.
sentences.zh: 那也是一个不同的政治时期。

sentences.en: In this context, they published the results quietly, and most of the researchers declined to discuss them.
sentences.zh: 在这种背景下，他们悄悄地发布了结果，大多数研究人员拒绝讨论它们。

sentences.en: What do you make of the reluctance to talk about what was found here?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待对讨论这里发现的结果的抵触情绪？

sentences.en: I mean, do you think it could raise questions that some of the researchers may be underplaying the significance of what they found?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为这是否会引发疑问，即一些研究人员可能在淡化他们所发现结果的重要性？

sentences.en: Certainly, when I was bouncing the results off of people, I got that question.
sentences.zh: 当然，当我向人们反馈这些结果时，我确实收到了这个问题。

sentences.en: Why are they publishing quietly?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们要悄悄发布？

sentences.en: Are they running away from their results?
sentences.zh: 他们是在逃避自己的结果吗？

sentences.en: I don't think that's quite right.
sentences.zh: 我不认为完全是这样。

sentences.en: They did publish them.
sentences.zh: 他们确实发布了。

sentences.en: They're not hiding them.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有隐瞒。

sentences.en: I think some of the reluctance involves talking about a paper that hasn't yet been peer-reviewed,
sentences.zh: 我认为这种抵触情绪部分涉及讨论一篇尚未经过同行评审的论文，

sentences.en: meaning it hasn't been fully vetted by other researchers and published in an academic journal.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它还没有经过其他研究人员的充分审查并发表在学术期刊上。

sentences.en: I think probably the more fundamental reluctance to talk about it is that they are ambivalent,
sentences.zh: 我认为更根本的抵触原因可能是他们感到矛盾，

sentences.en: and they do contradict this earlier finding that I think a lot of the researchers really found hopeful, that cash aid could really make a difference in children's lives.
sentences.zh: 而且这些结果确实与我之前认为许多研究人员真正感到充满希望的早期发现相矛盾，即现金援助确实能改变儿童的生活。

sentences.en: I think it's hard for all of us to really rethink something we fundamentally believe in, and all the more so in this case when there's confounding circumstances like the pandemic
sentences.zh: 我认为我们所有人都很难真正重新思考我们从根本上相信的东西，尤其是在这种情况下，当存在疫情这样的混杂因素时，

sentences.en: and the experiment isn't fully complete.
sentences.zh: 而且实验还没有完全完成。

sentences.en: That makes a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 这很有道理。

sentences.en: I guess I just think there will be some people listening to this who would say, you know, I get that scientists have hopes for their research,
sentences.zh: 我想会有一些听众会说，你知道，我明白科学家对他们的研究抱有希望，

sentences.en: but they shouldn't let that get in the way of being open to and really engaging with the results, even if the results aren't what you would want.
sentences.zh: 但他们不应该让这种希望阻碍他们保持开放态度并真正参与到结果中，即使结果不是你想要的。

sentences.en: And so, I mean, on those results, Jason, you've been looking at this stuff for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 所以，杰森，关于这些结果，你研究这些东西已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: What do you think this tells us about unconditional cash transfers?
sentences.zh: 你认为这告诉了我们关于无条件现金转移支付的什么信息？

sentences.en: How should we interpret this?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何解读这一点？

sentences.en: I want to be clear.
sentences.zh: 我想明确一点。

sentences.en: These results did not bear out progressives' hope that cash aid will unequivocally help children,
sentences.zh: 这些结果并没有证实进步派关于现金援助将明确帮助儿童的希望，

sentences.en: but they didn't bear out conservatives' fears that cash aid would hurt children either.
sentences.zh: 但它们也没有证实保守派关于现金援助会伤害儿童的担忧。

sentences.en: They didn't really provide full support for either side.
sentences.zh: 它们并没有真正为任何一方提供充分的支持。

sentences.en: I mean, the mothers didn't misspend the money, as some conservatives feared, and they didn't stop working.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，母亲们并没有像一些保守派担心的那样乱花钱，她们也没有停止工作。

sentences.en: You don't have to believe that cash aid will make a measurable cognitive difference in a child's development in order to support cash aid for kids.
sentences.zh: 你不必相信现金援助会在儿童的发展中产生可衡量的认知差异，才能支持为儿童提供现金援助。

sentences.en: You might just think it's a good thing to do, particularly in a world of such extreme inequality.
sentences.zh: 你可能只是认为这是一件好事，特别是在这样一个极端不平等的世界上。

sentences.en: And we don't impose a cognitive test on beneficiaries for most forms of government aid, right?
sentences.zh: 而且对于大多数形式的政府援助，我们不会对受益人进行认知测试，对吧？

sentences.en: There's other reasons to support giving poor families money.
sentences.zh: 支持给贫困家庭钱还有其他理由。

sentences.en: And the ethnographers involved in the study, the people who went out and interviewed the mothers, said that they heard mothers saying that the money was meaningful to them.
sentences.zh: 参与这项研究的人种学家，那些走出去采访母亲的人说，他们听到母亲们说这笔钱对她们很有意义。

sentences.en: They asked mothers to take pictures of what they did with it.
sentences.zh: 他们让母亲们拍下她们用这些钱做了什么的照片。

sentences.en: And one of the mothers sent in a picture of a new winter coat that she felt so proud that she had been able to give her kid.
sentences.zh: 其中一位母亲寄来了一张新冬衣的照片，她为自己能给孩子买到这件衣服感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: Now, that didn't translate into quantifiable changes in these benchmarks as they predicted.
sentences.zh: 现在，这并没有转化为他们预测的这些基准指标中的可量化变化。

sentences.en: But it may be meaningful nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 但它可能仍然是有意义的。

sentences.en: You know, there's other ways to measure meaning in a child's life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，衡量孩子生活意义的方法还有很多。

sentences.en: What do you think this means for the field overall, for people who are trying to find interventions to try to address this core problem,
sentences.zh: 你认为这对整个领域意味着什么，对于那些试图找到干预措施来解决这个核心问题的人来说，

sentences.en: that poor kids have worse outcomes than their more affluent peers?
sentences.zh: 即贫困儿童的成长结果比他们更富裕的同龄人更差？

sentences.en: Like, if you're a person trying to figure out what will improve early childhood development, what do you do now that you have this study that's saying that,
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你是一个试图找出什么能改善幼儿发展的人，现在有了这项研究，它说，

sentences.en: look, no strings cash, at least until now, hasn't had that effect?
sentences.zh: 看，无附加条件的现金，至少到目前为止，还没有产生那种效果，你该怎么办？

sentences.en: I mean, the question of whether poor kids have a fair shot at American life is just such a central question to American identity and to, you know, who we are as a people.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，贫困儿童是否在美国生活中拥有公平机会的问题，是美国身份认同以及我们作为一个民族是谁的核心问题。

sentences.en: I think the world's hungry for a solution.
sentences.zh: 我认为世界渴望一个解决方案。

sentences.en: And for me, having reported on this issue for decades,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，报道这个问题几十年了，

sentences.en: I'd say the results have just deepened the mystery of why some kids flourish and others don't.
sentences.zh: 我会说这些结果只是加深了为什么有些孩子茁壮成长而另一些孩子却没有的谜团。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a part of me that would have said, of course, the cash aid would make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我内心有一部分会说，当然，现金援助会有所作为。

sentences.en: Giving poor families more money is going to help poor families.
sentences.zh: 给贫困家庭更多的钱会帮助贫困家庭。

sentences.en: That's self-evident.
sentences.zh: 这是不言而喻的。

sentences.en: And then there's part of me that thinks, why would you think a few thousand dollars a year would make a meaningful difference
sentences.zh: 然后我内心有一部分会想，为什么你会认为每年几千美元会产生有意义的差异，

sentences.en: in a family's life when poor kids are up against so many things, from vast economic inequality to violent neighborhoods to bad schools to differences
sentences.zh: 当贫困儿童面临这么多困难时，从巨大的经济不平等、暴力社区、糟糕的学校，到

sentences.en: in parental education and ability to help them?
sentences.zh: 父母教育和帮助他们能力的差异？

sentences.en: I mean, it's just, you could make a list of 50 things.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以列出50件事。

sentences.en: I feel like as long as I've thought about this issue,
sentences.zh: 我觉得只要我还在思考这个问题，

sentences.en: I'm no closer to knowing the answer.
sentences.zh: 我就离知道答案没有更近一步。

sentences.en: And this study only deepens my puzzlement.
sentences.zh: 这项研究只会加深我的困惑。

sentences.en: Jason, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 杰森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the Republican-run House Oversight Committee subpoenaed the Justice Department for its files on Jeffrey Epstein and his longtime associate, Ghislaine Maxwell.
sentences.zh: 周二，共和党控制的众议院监督委员会向司法部发出传票，要求其提供有关杰弗里·爱泼斯坦及其长期合伙人吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦的文件。

sentences.en: The committee also sent subpoenas to 10 former Democratic and Republican officials it wants to depose in relation to the case, including Bill and Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 该委员会还向10名前民主党和共和党官员发出了传票，要求他们就此案进行作证，其中包括比尔·克林顿和希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: The committee's Republican chairman was required to send the subpoenas after Democrats forced a vote on the issue last month.
sentences.zh: 在民主党上个月强行就此问题进行投票后，该委员会的共和党主席被要求发出这些传票。

sentences.en: If the Justice Department doesn't deliver the documents by the August 19th deadline set by the committee, it could set up a showdown between the Trump administration and Congress
sentences.zh: 如果司法部未能在委员会设定的8月19日截止日期前提交文件，可能会导致特朗普政府与国会之间的对峙，

sentences.en: on an issue that's provoked outrage within the MAGA movement.
sentences.zh: 这在“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动中引发了愤怒。

sentences.en: Maxwell, who's serving a 20-year prison sentence for sexually exploiting and abusing teenage girls, asked a federal judge on Tuesday to deny the administration's request to unseal
sentences.zh: 因性剥削和虐待未成年少女而被判处20年监禁的麦克斯韦周二要求联邦法官拒绝政府提出的解封

sentences.en: the grand jury transcripts from the investigation against her and Epstein.
sentences.zh: 针对她和爱泼斯坦调查的大陪审团记录的请求。

sentences.en: Maxwell's lawyers said she'd never seen the material herself and that unsealing it would be a violation of grand jury secrecy.
sentences.zh: 麦克斯韦的律师表示，她本人从未见过这些材料，解封这些材料将违反大陪审团的保密原则。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Olivia Natt, Mary Wilson, and Jessica Chung.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由奥利维亚·纳特、玛丽·威尔逊和杰西卡·钟制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George with help from Lisa Chow and Lexi Diao.
sentences.zh: 由马克·乔治编辑，丽莎·周和莱克西·迪奥协助。

sentences.en: It contains original music by Pat McCusker and Rowan Nemistow and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 它包含帕特·麦卡斯克和罗文·内米斯托的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittroweck.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗韦克。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方收听。
